answerNotes.MELODICA: A melodica uses breath to sound free reeds selected by its keys.
answerNotes.MOUTHPIECE: Some players use an extension tube to place the instrument on a table.
answerNotes.REED: Each selected reed responds to airflow rather than a piano hammer.
answerNotes.KEYBOARD: The keys control airflow to reeds rather than striking strings.
answerNotes.TUBE: A tube can let a player use both hands at the keyboard.
